deliverables: fixtures/configs/ (Lite-distill and Pro-distill transformer/config.json from the Hub, with revisions)
kaggle/record_dit/ (CPU kernel for the stage B recording) and tests/unit/test_kaggle_record_dit.py

validation.name: stage A: tiny model final outputs vs recorded reference (float32), scenarios av (padded text mask, token types), rope_pos (custom visual_rope_pos with repeated 0), video_only
validation.criterion: rel_max <= 1e-4; (video,) without audio, (video, audio) with it

validation.name: stage A: every encoder and fused block output inside the model's own forward pass, all three scenarios
from_converted: converted directory with BF16-stored modulation and an unknown config key (is_multimodal)
validation.criterion: float32 load matches the reference at rel_max <= 1e-4; bf16 load keeps every time_embeddings/modulation parameter float32 and all others bf16, outputs bf16 with cosine >= 0.999

validation.name: real configs built without weights vs diffusers model on the meta device
validation.criterion: identical parameter names and shapes; equal parameter count

validation.name: stage B harness on a tiny model at Smoke size (3024 video tokens): torch recording with record_dit_real.py, conversion, MLX replay in float32
validation.criterion: every block (on recorded inputs and inside the forward pass) and the final outputs at rel_max <= 1e-4

validation.name: stage B harness on the tiny model in bf16 (sanity of the criterion, not a parity claim)
validation.criterion: rel_l2 <= 2 * torch bf16 rel_l2 and cosine >= 0.999

validation.name: real Lite-distill weights (VVladTech/Kandinsky-6.0-Lite-distill-5s-MLX@e4d652b7, SHA-256 62a3dba4...) load and run in bf16 at Smoke size; random inputs, no parity claim
validation.criterion: loads strictly, keeps the 268 modulation + 8 time-embedding tensors in float32, finite outputs of the reference shapes

skipped.what: stage B on the real Lite-distill weights (per-block and final bf16 parity)
skipped.reason: needs the float32 reference recording fixtures/real/dit_smoke from reference/record_dit_real.py, which runs on Kaggle (Lite in float32 is ~12.5 GB RAM; 11-13 GiB free disk here) and is an outward action waiting for the owner's approval. The converted transformer comes from VVladTech/Kandinsky-6.0-Lite-distill-5s-MLX@e4d652b7.

deviations.what: the model casts floating inputs (latents, text embeddings, pooled embedding, audio latents) to its dtype; the timestep stays as given
deviations.why: torch raises on a dtype mismatch, but MLX silently promotes a float32 input against bf16 weights and would run the whole model in float32. In float32 the cast is a no-op.

deviations.what: returns a tuple (video,) or (video, audio), like the reference with return_dict=False; there is no output dataclass
deviations.why: the pipeline (spec 09) is the only caller

deviations.what: stage B inputs: text embeddings computed from the study notebook's Smoke prompt with the pipeline's own encode_prompt (padded to 1024 tokens with the boolean mask) instead of the notebook's cache
deviations.why: the notebook's output holds no cached embeddings, and its cache drops the padding; keeping the mask exercises the masked path the pipeline uses.

follow_ups: Run reference/record_dit_real.py on Kaggle (CPU, inputs: k6-lite-diffusers-weights-media and -text outputs plus this repository's source) after approval, copy dit_smoke and smoke_text to fixtures/real/, then run `uv run pytest tests/parity/test_dit_real.py -m real_weights` and update this report.
fixtures/real/smoke_text from that run is the cached text-embedding input for spec 09.
